entities.summary: Jonatan Berggren is a Swedish professional ice hockey player who is a forward for the St. Louis Blues of the National Hockey League (NHL). Berggren was drafted in the second round, 33rd overall, by the Detroit Red Wings in the 2018 NHL entry draft.
